# Design point P015

## Description

Repository-service scaling would be implemented in and contributed to upstream Git, reducing reliance on specialized clients over time. Client maintenance would use single-pack full repacking as stated, but because that choice is rejected, it is not an accepted or fully coherent part of the resulting design.
